steps.en: Install Hex, launch it and grant microphone/input access
steps.zh: 安装并启动 Hex，授予麦克风和输入权限

steps.en: Prepare the local speech model on first run
steps.zh: 首次运行时准备本地语音模型

steps.en: Focus the target input, hold the shortcut, speak and release
steps.zh: 聚焦目标输入框，按住快捷键说话后松开

steps.en: Transcribe the recording on your device
steps.zh: 在你的设备上把录音转成文字

steps.en: Paste the final text into the focused app
steps.zh: 把最终文字粘贴到当前应用

value.en: Enter dictated messages without moving audio through a separate transcription window
value.zh: 说完即可输入消息，不必再转到独立窗口处理录音
